<function name="RegisterDermaMenuForClose" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Registers a Derma element to be closed the next time <page>Global.CloseDermaMenus</page> is called</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="menu" type="Panel">Menu to be registered for closure</arg>
	</args>
</function>
